## Judgment
Deploy to petunia. Owner decision (pi-durable Gitea #131, Stage 3a): pi-durable runs tool commands as a separate guest account `adurable`, not `agent`, so factory agents cannot read the owner's harness credentials. The Vault role ssh-client-signer/sign/durable is live (owner). No database change.
